family.description: This is a family of proteins that from part of the condensin complex that regulates chromosome segregation. This is the A subunit, which binds to the ScpB subunit, [pfam:PF04079], and SMC, [pfam:PF02463], to participate in chromosomal partition during cell division [[cite:PUB00109191],[cite:PUB00109192]]. The condensin complex pulls DNA away from the mid-cell into both cell halves [[cite:PUB00020315]]. These proteins are part of the Kleisin superfamily.
family.name: Segregation and condensation protein ScpA
